pr_body: Implements ADR 0125 in staged commits from the current main baseline. This first stage adds the GUI-free VFX authoring document, stable emitter/module/key IDs, typed Spawn/Update/Render modules, shared curve/gradient/value semantics, transactional authoring commands with canonical save/undo, deterministic validation and capacity diagnostics, templates, and backend-neutral CompiledVfxEffect IR. CPU runtime, simple-emitter unification, render outputs, engine.vfx_player, gameplay controls, and Builder integration follow on this same Draft PR.
